description: Changes one of your own materials (an id from list_my_materials): its name, oxide analysis in weight percent, loss on ignition or notes. Only what is given changes. Recipes already saved keep their own copy of it. The material as it was is kept as an earlier version, so the person can undo the change on the website. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

analysis.description: Its oxides in weight percent, as on a data sheet: { "SiO2": 68.5, "Al2O3": 17.4, "K2O": 9.8 }.

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

name: update_my_material
title: Change one of my materials
